elements.name: Motif Sketch
elements.description: Sketch a context diagram, turn it into a ports-and-adapters sketch, then export the diagrams and a solution plan

elements.name: Architect
elements.description: Sketches the context diagram, then the ports and adapters; exports diagrams and plan, and shares links

elements.name: Viewer
elements.description: Opens a diagram someone shared, read-only

elements.name: Clipboard
elements.description: Where Copy link puts a snapshot link, ready to paste

elements.name: Project Files
elements.description: Saved projects: one file per system holding the context diagram and, once started, its ports-and-adapters sketch
elements.technology: Local files (.motifsketch.json, saved in place or downloaded)

elements.name: Browser Storage
elements.description: Autosaved work in progress and its file handle, so a refresh or closed tab loses nothing and Save still goes to the same file

elements.name: Diagram Exports
elements.description: The context diagram and the ports-and-adapters sketch as pictures

elements.name: Solution Plans
elements.description: The solution stub plan a coding agent builds from

adapters.name: Web App
adapters.description: One app for the Architect (full editing) and the Viewer (read-only, opened from a snapshot link). HexaSketch allows only one source per adapter, so the Viewer shows as not placed

adapters.name: Specs
adapters.description: Checks that drive the application through the User port, using the fake driven adapters. In Motif Sketch this is kind Checks; HexaSketch only knows Fake

adapters.name: Browser Files
adapters.technology: File System Access API, download fallback
adapters.description: Saved projects: one file per system holding the context diagram and, once started, its ports-and-adapters sketch

ports.name: Autosave
ports.description: Keeps the work in progress and its file handle between visits

adapters.name: IndexedDB
adapters.description: Autosaved work in progress and its file handle, so a refresh or closed tab loses nothing and Save still goes to the same file

ports.name: Diagram Exports
ports.description: Writes the context diagram and the sketch as pictures

adapters.name: SVG Files
adapters.technology: Browser Files (File System Access API, download fallback)
adapters.description: The context diagram and the ports-and-adapters sketch as pictures

ports.name: Solution Stubs
ports.description: Hands the solution stub on to be built; v2 may add a GitHub adapter that inflates it in a repo

adapters.name: Markdown Plan
adapters.technology: Browser Files (File System Access API, download fallback)
adapters.description: The solution stub plan a coding agent builds from

ports.name: Clipboard
ports.description: Takes the snapshot link when the Architect copies it

adapters.description: Where Copy link puts a snapshot link, ready to paste
